descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 30 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
Your smart home, right in front of you.

HomePanel MR brings your Home Assistant devices into mixed reality on Meta Quest 3 and Quest 3S. Place a small marker near a real device, look toward it to reveal controls, and select an action with your hands. Look away and the controls fade out.

• Switch lights and individual switch channels.
• Adjust supported light brightness, fan speed and thermostat temperature.
• Open, close or stop supported covers.
• Browse rooms and everyday devices, with an All devices view for advanced functions.
• Save separate placements for each device channel.
• Use English or Vietnamese.

REQUIREMENTS
A working Home Assistant server, an account on that server, compatible configured devices and network access from the headset are required for real device control. Home Assistant and smart-home hardware are not included. Available actions depend on your devices and integrations. Room placement requires Meta room setup and spatial-data permission.

A built-in demo lets you explore sample devices without connecting a server. Connection credentials are stored locally using Android Keystore encryption when you choose to remember them.

HomePanel MR is an independent app, not affiliated with the Open Home Foundation or Meta.
